contradictions.what: Rep says we were the favourite right before Halima's remark, yet the support-plan walkthrough that drew silence was already underway and he never tested her concern.
Rep thought the load test had won it, yet Halima's only reaction was 'good' and she was asking for people and an on-sale plan.
Trigger was a support failure (ticket form, late reply), yet the rep answered with support tiers and says nobody said support; the core need was visible early.
Rep says we were the better platform, but the decider says she buys what happens when it's down, not uptime, and we lost.
Payments had failed twice before per Ben, but rep frames this failure as the trigger because the CEO saw it for the first time.

dodges.what: Rep relayed only Ben's report of the competitor meeting, then gave his own over-promise theory, admitted unverified. The competitor is never named, and nothing on product, price or contract was given.
